What we build

Our latest robots

Every year we pick a competition and design, build, and program a machine for it from scratch — mechanical, electrical, and software, all in house.

RoboSub

Our first autonomous underwater vehicle, taking the team below the surface for the first time and into a new class of competition.

2024–25

Sumobot 2025

A 20 lb autonomous sumobot built for the National Robotics Challenge — find the opponent, and push it out of the ring.

2022–24

IGVC

A fully autonomous ground vehicle for the Intelligent Ground Vehicle Competition — lidar, stereo vision, and lane following over two years of entries.

Multidisciplinary by design

Autonomous ground vehicles, combat robots, underwater vehicles, and a trebuchet that throws pumpkins down Main Street. Our robots are built from scratch, so they need mechanical design, electronics, and software in equal measure — and every major is welcome on the team.

Get to know us

No experience required. Show up to a meeting or a workday and we will find you something to build.

About the team

We are the South Dakota Mines Rocker Robotics Team, part of the Mines CAMP program. Design starts in the fall semester and competition follows in the spring.

Learn more

When we meet

  • Meetings Thursdays, 4:04 pm — M306
  • Workdays Wednesdays, 5:00 pm
  • Saturdays, 12:00 pm
  • Labs McLaury 101 & 107

Outreach

We run demos at middle school events, festivals, and Mines events, and mentor FIRST Lego League teams around the Black Hills.
